sentences.text_target: Tom checked his schedule before leaving his home.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm tʃekt hɪz ˈʃedjuːl bɪˈfɔːr ˈliːvɪŋ hɪz həʊm/
sentences.text_native: Tom a vérifié son emploi du temps avant de quitter sa maison.

sentences.text_target: He walked down the street toward the train station.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːkt daʊn ðə striːt təˈwɔːd ðə treɪn ˈsteɪʃn/
sentences.text_native: Il a descendu la rue en direction de la gare.

sentences.text_target: A heavy rain started to fall from the grey sky.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈhevi reɪn ˈstɑːtɪd tuː fɔːl frɒm ðə ɡreɪ skaɪ/
sentences.text_native: Une forte pluie a commencé à tomber du ciel gris.

sentences.text_target: He put on his warm coat and started to run.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊt ɒn hɪz wɔːm kəʊt ænd ˈstɑːtɪd tuː rʌn/
sentences.text_native: Il a enfilé son manteau chaud et s'est mis à courir.

sentences.text_target: When he arrived at the platform, he saw a big problem.
sentences.phonetic: /wen hiː əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈplætfɔːm, hiː sɔː ə bɪɡ ˈprɒbləm/
sentences.text_native: Quand il est arrivé sur le quai, il a vu un gros problème.

sentences.text_target: An electronic board showed a long delay for his usual train.
sentences.phonetic: /ən ɪlekˈtrɒnɪk bɔːd ʃəʊd ə lɒŋ dɪˈleɪ fɔːr hɪz ˈjuːʒuəl treɪn/
sentences.text_native: Un panneau électronique affichait un long retard pour son train habituel.

sentences.text_target: Many people were waiting and complaining near the closed door.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmeni ˈpiːpl wɜː ˈweɪtɪŋ ænd kəmˈpleɪɪŋ nɪə ðə kləʊzd dɔː/
sentences.text_native: Beaucoup de gens attendaient et se plaignaient près de la porte fermée.

sentences.text_target: Tom realized he would miss his important meeting if he waited.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈriːəlaɪzd hiː wʊd mɪs hɪz ɪmˈpɔːtənt ˈmiːtɪŋ ɪf hiː ˈweɪtɪd/
sentences.text_native: Tom a réalisé qu'il raterait sa réunion importante s'il attendait.

sentences.text_target: He needed to find an alternative route immediately.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈniːdɪd tuː faɪnd ən ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv ruːt ɪˈmiːdiətli/
sentences.text_native: Il devait trouver un autre itinéraire immédiatement.

sentences.text_target: He opened a map application on his smartphone.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈəʊpənd ə mæp ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃn ɒn hɪz ˈsmɑːtfəʊn/
sentences.text_native: Il a ouvert une application de cartographie sur son smartphone.

sentences.text_target: The screen showed that taking a bus was a good option.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə skriːn ʃəʊd ðæt ˈteɪkɪŋ ə bʌs wɒz ə ɡʊd ˈɒpʃn/
sentences.text_native: L'écran indiquait que prendre le bus était une bonne option.

sentences.text_target: He left the station and walked quickly to the nearest bus stop.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː left ðə ˈsteɪʃn ænd wɔːkt ˈkwikli tuː ðə ˈnɪərɪst bʌs stɒp/
sentences.text_native: Il a quitté la gare et a marché d'un pas vif jusqu'à l'arrêt de bus le plus proche.

sentences.text_target: Traffic on the main road was moving very slowly because of the rain.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈtræfɪk ɒn ðə meɪn rəʊd wɒz ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈveri ˈsləʊli bɪˈkɒz ɒv ðə reɪn/
sentences.text_native: La circulation sur l'avenue avançait très lentement à cause de la pluie.

sentences.text_target: Cars and trucks formed a long line around the corner.
sentences.phonetic: /kɑːz ænd trʌks fɔːmd ə lɒŋ laɪn əˈraʊnd ðə ˈkɔːnə/
sentences.text_native: Voitures et camions formaient une longue file dans le tournant.

sentences.text_target: He understood that the bus journey would take too much time.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˌʌndəˈstʊd ðæt ðə bʌs ˈdʒɜːni wʊd teɪk tuː mʌtʃ taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Il a compris que le trajet en bus prendrait trop de temps.

sentences.text_target: Then he remembered the public bike rental service nearby.
sentences.phonetic: /ðen hiː rɪˈmembəd ðə ˈpʌblɪk baɪk ˈrentl ˈsɜːvɪs ˈnɪəbaɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il s'est alors souvenu du service de location de vélos en libre-service à proximité.

sentences.text_target: He walked to the bike rack and took out his payment card.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːkt tuː ðə baɪk ræk ænd tʊk aʊt hɪz ˈpeɪmənt kɑːd/
sentences.text_native: Il s'est dirigé vers le râtelier à vélos et a sorti sa carte bancaire.

sentences.text_target: He paid quickly, unlocked a red bicycle, and put on his helmet.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː peɪd ˈkwikli, ʌnˈlɒkt ə red ˈbaɪsɪkl, ænd pʊt ɒn hɪz ˈhelmɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il a payé rapidement, a déverrouillé un vélo rouge et a mis son casque.

sentences.text_target: Riding a bike in the city center required a lot of attention.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈraɪdɪŋ ə baɪk ɪn ðə ˈsɪti ˈsentə rɪˈkwaɪəd ə lɒt ɒv əˈtenʃn/
sentences.text_native: Rouler à vélo dans le centre-ville demandait beaucoup d'attention.

sentences.text_target: He followed the safe bike path along the river.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈfɒləʊd ðə seɪf baɪk pɑːθ əˈlɒŋ ðə ˈrɪvə/
sentences.text_native: Il a emprunté la piste cyclable aménagée le long de la rivière.

sentences.text_target: Many pedestrians were crossing the street at the special crosswalk.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmeni pəˈdestriənz wɜː ˈkrɒsɪŋ ðə striːt æt ðə ˈspeʃl ˈkrɒswɔːk/
sentences.text_native: De nombreux piétons traversaient la rue sur le passage piéton.

sentences.text_target: Tom stopped respectfully and let the people pass safely.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm stɒpt rɪˈspektfʊli ænd let ðə ˈpiːpl pɑːs ˈseɪfli/
sentences.text_native: Tom s'est arrêté courtoisement pour laisser passer les gens en toute sécurité.

sentences.text_target: The rain stopped slowly as he crossed the big old bridge.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə reɪn stɒpt ˈsləʊli æz hiː krɒst ðə bɪɡ əʊld brɪdʒ/
sentences.text_native: La pluie a peu à peu cessé alors qu'il traversait le vieux pont.

sentences.text_target: The fresh air felt good after the stressful minutes at the station.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə freʃ eə felt ɡʊd ˈɑːftə ðə ˈstresfʊl ˈmɪnɪts æt ðə ˈsteɪʃn/
sentences.text_native: L'air frais lui a fait du bien après les minutes stressantes passées à la gare.

sentences.text_target: He turned right into a quiet street near his office building.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tɜːnd raɪt ˈɪntuː ə ˈkwaɪət striːt nɪə hɪz ˈɒfɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il a tourné à droite dans une rue calme près de son immeuble de bureaux.

sentences.text_target: He found a convenient parking space for the bicycle near the entrance.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː faʊnd ə kənˈviːniənt ˈpɑːkɪŋ speɪs fɔː ðə ˈbaɪsɪkl nɪə ði ˈentrəns/
sentences.text_native: Il a trouvé un emplacement pratique pour garer le vélo près de l'entrée.

sentences.text_target: He locked the bike securely and took off his wet coat.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː lɒkt ðə baɪk sɪˈkjʊəli ænd tʊk ɒf hɪz wet kəʊt/
sentences.text_native: Il a attaché solidement le vélo et a retiré son manteau mouillé.

sentences.text_target: Finally, he reached his destination just before the meeting started.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, hiː riːtʃt hɪz ˌdestɪˈneɪʃn dʒʌst bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈstɑːtɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il a enfin atteint sa destination juste avant le début de la réunion.

sentences.text_target: He walked through the glass door and sat at his desk.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːkt θruː ðə ɡlɑːs dɔː ænd sæt æt hɪz desk/
sentences.text_native: Il a franchi la porte vitrée et s'est installé à son bureau.

sentences.text_target: Despite the travel problems, he was happy to be on time.
sentences.phonetic: /dɪˈspaɪt ðə ˈtrævl ˈprɒbləmz, hiː wɒz ˈhæpi tuː biː ɒn taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Malgré les péripéties du trajet, il était heureux d'être à l'heure.
